assets.name: OceanReef
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished portrait 9:16 mobile game habitat background, no UI. Primary request: an adorable 8-bit pixel art underwater ocean reef for Recycli, a virtual pet habitat. Crisp deliberately chunky square pixels, limited teal turquoise aqua sand cream coral pink palette, charming cozy retro handheld RPG game art. Upper 45 percent calm open turquoise water with subtle stepped sun rays and a few tiny bubbles, intentionally quiet for UI. Sandy seabed starts at 56 percent down, big flat open sandy play area across the middle and bottom for separately rendered draggable pets. Layered rocky reef and colorful coral along the extreme left and right edges, a few seaweed tufts. Visible seabed in the lower third. Straight-on slightly elevated game diorama perspective, no horizon sky, no text, no labels, no creatures, no fish, no UI, no borders, no watermark. Full-bleed portrait background, 9:16 aspect ratio. Do not paint the separately rendered pets or shop items.

assets.name: FriendsAndFood
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel art game sprite atlas. Create exactly twelve separate cute chunky 8-bit sprites, arranged as a perfectly regular grid FOUR columns by THREE rows on a genuine transparent alpha background. Every cell same size with each sprite centered and ample transparent padding on all sides; sprites occupy only the middle 68 percent of each cell and never touch another cell. Grid itself invisible. Canvas 4:3 landscape. SAME crisp thick square pixels and dark charcoal colored outlines throughout, simple black shiny eyes and friendly happy expressions for the animals, no antialiasing look, limited retro handheld game palette. Exact row-major ordering: ROW 1: orange-and-white clownfish facing right, small mint green sea turtle, pink baby octopus, sky-blue baby dolphin facing right. ROW 2: round blue-white baby penguin, fluffy white arctic fox with lavender ears, pale gray baby seal, fluffy cream snow hare with tall ears. ROW 3: a small basket of red woodland berries, a tied bundle of green kelp leaves, a little bowl of golden crunchy star-shaped pet treats, a shiny red apple with green leaf. Each is an isolated object or character, no floor shadows, no scenery, no ground, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no checkerboard drawn into image. Truly transparent background. Make all twelve easy to read as small icons. Keep each object entirely within its cell.

assets.name: HabitatDecor
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel art game decoration atlas. Exactly nine separate adorable 8-bit game objects in a perfectly regular grid THREE columns by THREE rows, each centered in its equal square cell with generous transparent padding, occupying only center 68 percent. Genuine transparent alpha background, no drawn checkerboard. Crisp chunky square pixel art with dark colored pixel outlines and a limited cozy retro handheld palette. Exact row-major order: ROW 1 woodland decorations: a rustic wooden bench with two legs, a tiny warm glowing garden lantern on a short wooden post, a small fern plant with several green fronds. ROW 2 ocean decorations: a peach-pink branching coral, a lavender open clam shell with one cream pearl, a small sandcastle with three towers. ROW 3 snowy decorations: a tiny blue-white igloo with arched door, a little snowman with red scarf and twig arms, a short snow-covered spruce tree. All nine are isolated single decorative objects seen from a consistent front three-quarter game perspective. No pets, no labels, no text, no grid lines, no scenery, no floor or ground shadows, no UI. Each stays well inside its own cell. Square canvas.
